meta.name: dhdna-profiler
meta.description: Extract cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text. Use this skill when the user wants to analyze how someone thinks, understand cognitive style, profile writing or speech patterns, compare thinking styles between people, asks "what's my thinking style", "analyze how this person reasons", "cognitive profile", "thinking pattern", "DHDNA", "digital DNA", or wants to understand the mind behind any text. Also trigger when the user provides text and wants deeper insight into the author's reasoning patterns, decision-making style, or cognitive signature.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析任意文本中的认知模式与思维指纹
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想了解自己或他人的思考方式和认知风格
copy.tagline_en: Analyze cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand the thinking style and cognitive signature behind any text

howto.what: 它会从文本中提取作者的认知模式,按 12 个维度(如分析深度、创造性、情绪处理等)分别打分,并生成包含主导模式、推理拓扑、决策指纹的画像;也支持比较多个人的思维或根据对话历史做自我画像。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析思维风格或认知画像、提供文本想解读其推理模式,或比较不同作者的思维时触发。

say.text: 分析这段文字作者的思维风格。
say.note: 对文本生成 DHDNA 画像。

say.text: 这是我的写作样本,给我做一份认知画像。
say.note: 按提供的样例进行自我画像。

say.text: 比较这两段文字的思维差异。
say.note: 进入比较模式,输出对比结果。

howto.what_en: Extracts cognitive patterns from any text, scores 12 dimensions (analytical depth, creativity, emotion, etc.), and outputs a profile with dominant pattern, reasoning topology, decision fingerprint; also supports comparing multiple authors and self-profiling from conversation history.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to analyze someone's thinking style or cognitive profile, provides text for deeper insight into reasoning/decision patterns, or compares thinking styles between people.

say_en.note: Generates a DHDNA profile from the text.

say_en.text: This is my writing sample. Profile my thinking.
say_en.note: Self-profile based on the provided sample.

say_en.text: Compare the thinking in these two texts.
say_en.note: Enters comparison mode and outputs a contrast.
